summary.text: Bryan Allen is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent K.C. Tomlinson (R).
He won the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Allen previously ran for the Pennsylvania State Senate in 2010, when he defeated John Jordan in the May 18 Democratic primary and lost the November 2 general election to Republican Robert Tomlinson.
According to his 2010 campaign website, his issues included an education funding formula that gives every child the same chance to succeed and putting a constitutional convention on the ballot.
